full.en: MATCHA CHAI Herbal Latte, 125 g. Matcha green tea, spiced with cinnamon and naturally sweetened with coconut sugar. Ingredients: rice drink powder*, (rice *, OAT beta glucans*, sunflower oil *, salt), green tea matcha (Camellia sinensis) powder (20 %)*, coconut sugar*, cinnamon (cinnamomum zeylanicum) (5 %)*, ginger (zingiber officinale) (3 %)*. organic*. Using instructions: mix 2 teaspoons (10 g) of powder in a cup (200 mL) of hot water. For a better taste add a bit of plant based milk and stir well. Storage: To be stored in cool and dry place. Warrnings: If you are taking anticoagulant medications or have liver or gallbladder disease, consult your doctor before use.
